ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Beta Calendars Temporal Toolkit provides presentation-neutral calendar
structures based on Python's standard date types. It generates configurable
month and year grids, bounded recurrence dates, date ranges, and calendar
boundary metadata. The package also includes deterministic JSON, CSV, and
Markdown serializers and a command-line interface.
about.summary: Deterministic calendar grids, date ranges, recurrence helpers, and boundary utilities for Python.

script: python -c "from betacalendars import month_grid; grid = month_grid(2027, 1, week_start='monday', fixed_rows=True, include_overflow=True); assert len(grid.cells) == 42"

name: betacalendars-temporal
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.0"

package:
  name: betacalendars-temporal
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/mateopedersen/betacalendars-temporal/releases/download/v${{ version }}/betacalendars_temporal-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 786b88b2e58d879e78f871546a2872f286a09c13722b353aec7e686c0c90dbe5

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - betacal = betacalendars.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - betacalendars
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - betacal --version
      - betacal month 2027 1 --format json
      - python -c "from betacalendars import month_grid; grid = month_grid(2027, 1, week_start='monday', fixed_rows=True, include_overflow=True); assert len(grid.cells) == 42"
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://www.betacalendars.com/
  repository: https://github.com/mateopedersen/betacalendars-temporal
  documentation: https://github.com/mateopedersen/betacalendars-temporal#readme
  summary: Deterministic calendar grids, date ranges, recurrence helpers, and boundary utilities for Python.
  description: |
    Beta Calendars Temporal Toolkit provides presentation-neutral calendar
    structures based on Python's standard date types. It generates configurable
    month and year grids, bounded recurrence dates, date ranges, and calendar
    boundary metadata. The package also includes deterministic JSON, CSV, and
    Markdown serializers and a command-line interface.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mateopedersen
